package.name: unitree_go
package.description:
Minimal unitree_go message package for ltw-camera-server (0.5-foxy-planB).
Contains only the message definitions actually needed by our container: Go2FrontVideoData, matching the topic /frontvideostream published by videohub_pc4 (system service running on the host as root).
Field definitions copied verbatim from the host's production tree at /upgradePythonServer/temp/unitree/module/graph_pid_ws/src/unitree_go/msg/ so wire format (DDSI-RTPS) matches the publisher automatically — DDS guarantees wire compatibility when field definitions match, regardless of the language or CMakeLists.txt used to generate typesupport.
To add more messages later (depth, IMU, etc.): copy the corresponding .msg file from the host tree into msg/ and add a line to CMakeLists.txt.
Not affiliated with Unitree Robotics.
